_comment: Documented divergences of the Go engine against the event_stream corpus (kind events). Fail-closed: a failing case NOT listed here is red; a listed case that starts reproducing the reference envelopes is red (stale baseline); a listed case that never ran is red. The corpus-advisory xfail case (evt_decoding_error_unreachable) is skipped by the runner and needs no entry. The event-pipeline wave closed every envelope gap the engine could reproduce: the remaining seven are the compile-time detection corpus (three), two host error-text renderings, one harness URL artifact and one scenario-mapping artifact.

cases.event_stream/evt_country_blocked_geo: scenario-mapping artifact: the reference corpus drives IPInfoManager.check_country_access directly, whose Go verdict lives in the ip_security check (guardcore/pipeline.go), so the driven check adds the reference decorator_violation access-denied event beside country_blocked; the country_blocked envelope itself matches
cases.event_stream/evt_geo_lookup_failed_downl: the download-failure reason renders the Go error type ('*url.Error') where the reference pins the python exception class name ('RuntimeError'); the envelope is otherwise identical
cases.event_stream/evt_https_enforced_redirect: the harness pins url_replace_scheme to the scheme-swapped origin without the path (pipeline_harness._PipelineRequest.url_replace_scheme); the Go engine mirrors the real adapters and renders the full request URL (https://example.com/api)
cases.event_stream/evt_pattern_added_custom: the Go detection corpus is a compile-time table (KNOWN_GAPS): no sus-patterns runtime registry exists, so pattern_added has no emitter
cases.event_stream/evt_pattern_detected_xss: the Go detection corpus is a compile-time table (KNOWN_GAPS): guardcore.Detect is a pure function with no sus-patterns telemetry seam, so pattern_detected has no emitter
cases.event_stream/evt_pattern_removed_custom: the Go detection corpus is a compile-time table (KNOWN_GAPS): no sus-patterns runtime registry exists, so pattern_removed has no emitter
cases.event_stream/evt_redis_error_connection_: the envelope matches except the reason column, which quotes the redis-py exception rendering; the Go client renders its own dial error text
